messages:
ashley: Heads-up — getting a surge of internal request failures from model-serving in us-east-1 this morning. Traces show repeated DNS lookups timing out when resolving service names (e.g. "svc-user.svc.cluster.local"). Tail DNS latency jumped to ~700ms and a few 504s. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: Yup, saw client retries from our feature-store sidecar. Logs show a lot of `lookup svc-user.svc.cluster.local: i/o timeout` and repeated UDP retransmits. Started after the nodepool image rollout last night.

li: I captured a quick pcap between node-local cache and CoreDNS. Observed many UDP fragments + ICMP "fragmentation needed" messages. Looks like a PMTU mismatch: some hosts still advertising MTU 9000 while overlay tunnels/host routes enforce 1500. Also saw retransmits on RDMA-enabled paths where the NIC was configured for jumbo frames.

maria: Interesting — we switched VXLAN encapsulation and upgraded the CNI provider in that rollout. VXLAN reduces effective MTU; if any intermediate link keeps jumbo enabled we get fragmentation or blackholing. Workaround we used before: force DNS upstream to TCP for larger responses or lower node-local cache max-udp-size.

raj: Noted. Quick ops impact: when DNS tails spike, our controller loops retry more, triggering reactive GPU node provisioning. That spikes cost and can push GPU pools into temporary overcommit as pods backoff. We should avoid reactive scale until DNS stabilized.

sam: Repro commands I ran: 

```
# on affected node
ip link show eth0
ip -s -d link show eth0
# tcpdump filter between pod ip and coredns
tcpdump -n -i any udp and port 53 -w dns-frag.pcap
```

I can share pcap. Shows DNS responses split into fragments and subsequent ICMP "frag needed, DF set".

li: Plan proposal: 1) temporarily set node-local cache to force TCP for upstream with `--upstream-tcp` OR lower `max_udp_payload_size` to 1232, 2) revert CNI MTU change on a canary AZ, 3) verify RDMA/NIC MTU alignment across host->switch->tunnel. I can run packet captures and MTU diffs.

ashley: Sounds good. Action items: li — gather pcap + per-node `ip link`+`ethtool` and post findings (assign to infra-incident). sam — open support ticket with NIC vendor and CNI provider (include pcap). raj — freeze automatic GPU scale-ups for us-east-1 for the next 30m and add small reserve to avoid churn. I'll create a quick kanban card and tag PMs.

maria: I'll also spin a canary that routes DNS to a headless kube-dns pod in the same AZ (bypass node-local cache) to validate whether node-local cache is part of the failure surface.

deploy-bot: Rollout 2026-03-18T08:12 by @ci: nodepool-image v2.14 started in us-east-1 (canaries: 2/50).

raj: thumbs up. Keep us posted — if we confirm PMTU blackhole we should add MTU verification to the nodepool rollout checklist. :thumbsup:

ashley: Thanks — please post pcap link and a short summary when you have it. I'll pause any further rollouts until we confirm the root cause. :white_check_mark:
